about_the_game:
"Step into the mystic realms between order and chaos.

A place humans abandoned, where nightmares are given form.

As a lone wanderer, you’ll descend into worlds filled with deadly foes and rare loot waiting to be unearthed.

Every run is a new test of skill, creativity, and survival."

---

Skill and Movement based Combat

Master a fluid, responsive combat system, with creative ways to move around the map, and to slash monsters. Every weapon has its own attack pattern and rhythm, letting you adapt your fighting style to any threat that stands in your way. 

Attack or auto-attack, dodge and strike creatively to stay in flow.

Near-Infinite Build Potential

No two runs are the same. Combine skills, items, and knowledge to create your own playstyle. Discover powerful synergies, experiment with combos, and create builds that defy the limits of possibility.

Create your character and choose from a big and diverse variety of classes, each with its own strengths and challenges, to experiment with the gigantic arsenal of powerful skills and items.

Develop your build to the next level, with gear of various rarities and the deep and unique stat-system.

Loot, Grow, and Evolve

Collect powerful gear, unlock permanent upgrades, and evolve through a web of traits that persist across worlds. Each victory fuels your progression, granting new tools and strategies for the next descent into darkness.

Manage your equipment, to stay powerful enough to conquer new challenges.

Explore Forsaken Worlds

Traverse the Nexus, and explore dozens of maps: From underworld ruins, or vivid jungles filled with dangerous traps, to otherworldly voids where reality bends. Dynamic events ensure no two journeys are alike, each dripping with mystery.

Every world brings new trials: Unique quests, deadly encounters, and colossal bosses with their own attack patterns and bullet-hell-like fury. Learn their moves and adapt your build to carve your name into their flesh.

Death Is Not the End

Each defeat is a lesson. Each run brings new knowledge and potential. Rise stronger and more prepared, until you’ve conquered the darkness that binds you to this dark place.

Keep collected items from runs, to gear up your character and support your build, before going into the next run. Adding a consistent challenge with different map and loot tiers, to ensure interesting gameplay all the time.

Key Features

  • Fluid and intuitive combat

  • Near-infinite build variety and weapon synergies

  • Handcrafted, detailed worlds

  • Deep progression system with many permanent upgrades

  • Rich and immersive dark-fantasy atmosphere

name: Obsydian

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD Phenom II X4 970
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTS 250, 1 GB / AMD Radeon HD 6670, 1 GB
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4570 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 Ti, 2 GB / AMD Radeon R7 360, 2 GB
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A dark fantasy ARPG with roguelike elements, and near-endless build possibilities. Slash through monsters, loot rare gear, and evolve through worlds of myth.
